appearances.whereabouts: Travels from northern hills into Cairhien city via the Foregate, takes rooms at The Defender of the Dragonwall inn, explores the Foregate, encounters Thom at a performance hall
appearances.notable_actions: Arrives at Cairhien with Loial and Hurin under escort of Tavolin's soldiers; registers at city gate; rejects invitations from three noble Houses by burning them in the inn's fireplace; searches for Selene; asks gate officers to inquire about her; explores the Foregate; discovers Thom Merrilin alive and performing; arranges to meet Thom later
appearances.demeanor: uncomfortable with lordly pretense, irritated by Cairhienin formality and Daes Dae'mar, relieved and joyful upon finding Thom alive, eager to leave Cairhien

appearances.whereabouts: Travels with Rand into Cairhien, takes rooms at The Defender of the Dragonwall, stays in the inn to guard the Horn
appearances.notable_actions: Carries the Horn of Valere wrapped in a blanket; observes the Topless Towers being rebuilt without Ogier stonemasons; volunteers to take first watch on the Horn; declines to explore the city to avoid other Ogier
appearances.demeanor: sad about the state of the Topless Towers, anxious about encountering other Ogier who might have heard from his home stedding

appearances.whereabouts: Travels with Rand into Cairhien, takes rooms at The Defender of the Dragonwall, stays in the inn common room
appearances.notable_actions: Guides the group through the city; advises Rand on Cairhienin customs and Daes Dae'mar; explains the history of Foregate peasants; warns Rand about the consequences of burning invitations; declines to visit the Foregate due to the violence there
appearances.demeanor: respectful and increasingly deferential to Rand as a lord, knowledgeable about Cairhien, cautious about local politics

appearances.whereabouts: Escorts Rand's party from Tremonsien to Cairhien, enters the city with them, goes to the guardhouse at the gate
appearances.notable_actions: Leads fifty soldiers escorting Rand's group; clears a path through Foregate crowds with his soldiers; shows disgust at Foregate peasants; brings officer Sandair to register the visitors; repeatedly looks at the blanket-wrapped chest but never asks what's inside
appearances.demeanor: stiff, formal, disgusted by the Foregate and its people, increasingly rigid the further south they travel

appearances.whereabouts: At the guardhouse inside Cairhien's gate
appearances.notable_actions: Records Rand, Loial, and Hurin in the official ledger; instructs them to return within a day to report their inn; reacts with surprise to Rand's question about staying in the Foregate; agrees to inquire about Selene
appearances.demeanor: official, bureaucratic, surprised by Rand's unconventional requests

appearances.whereabouts: At The Defender of the Dragonwall inn
appearances.notable_actions: Initially startles at seeing the group, especially Loial; quickly becomes obsequious upon recognizing Rand as a lord; arranges their rooms; presents invitations from three noble Houses to Rand
appearances.demeanor: unctuous, obsequious, eager to please, briefly mistakes Rand for Aiel before recovering

appearances.whereabouts: Performing in a large hall in the Foregate
appearances.notable_actions: Performs stories including the tale of Rogosh Eagle-eye and Dunsinin; recognizes Rand in the audience; signals Rand to meet him backstage; explains how he survived Whitebridge and why he didn't go to Illian; complains about audiences only wanting The Great Hunt of the Horn; arranges to meet Rand at The Bunch of Grapes inn; demands his harp and flute back
appearances.demeanor: proud of his craft, disdainful of lesser performers, pragmatic about his survival, pleased but unsurprised to see Rand, interested in Moiraine's whereabouts

appearances.whereabouts: Unknown location in Cairhien (not present in chapter)
appearances.notable_actions: Has left a note for Rand saying she will wait for him in Cairhien; Rand asks the gate officers to inquire about her

appearances.whereabouts: Not present in chapter but mentioned as ruling from Cairhien
